title: Connection Packet Fixer
description: Relaxes packet limits, errors, timeouts, and other connection related issues
body:
# Connection Packet Fixer

Relaxes packet limits, connection timeouts, packet decode exceptions, and payload issues.

## Details

- Raises common login, compression, chunk, and NBT packet limits.
- Extends login, read, and keepalive timeouts.
- Bounds slow disconnect cleanup so closed channels do not hang forever.
- Blocks repeated malformed pre-login traffic.
- Can suppress client disconnects from signed chat verification failures.
